Meeting Minutes: 
The president welcomed all the IIC council members for the first meeting. Vice President given a 
brief overview of activities under IIC, MIC, Celebration Day and Self-driven activities held in the 
Board room 
Agenda: 
 
  l. Formulate Council Members  
 2. IIC Calendar Activity 
 3. MIC Driven Activity 
 4. Self-Driven Activity 
 5. Celebration Day Activities 
 
Agenda Point 1: The Head of the institution proposed formation of   IIC council.  
 
Resolution:  
Formed the IIC chaired by President Dr. N Sudhakar Reddy along with committee members. 
New Student and faculty members are proposed and approved by the Council members. 
 
Agenda Point 2: IIC discussed to prepare Calendar Activities for the Quarter 1.  
Resolution: Prepared Calendar Activities for the Quarter 1 and approved by IIC President and other 
Members.   
Agenda Point 3: IIC Council discussed to prepare MIC Calendar Activities for the Quarter 1.
